name: Airware

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Jonathan Downey is an experienced technology entrepreneur, CEO, and investor, having founded three AI companies and invested in more than 50 startups including Cruise, Observe.AI, Culture Amp, Ginkgo Bioworks, and Verge Genomics.
He is currently the co-founder and CEO of Everyday Agents, a stealth startup building an AI-native Travel Concierge that simplifies the process of discovering, planning, and booking trips, all in one app.

founders.title: Founder/Vice President Operations & Business Development
founders.founder_bio:
My mission is to help families launch their kids into life.

My companies, Launch and Prompt, support hundreds of college admissions consultants to help tens of thousands of families launch their kids into life.

Previously, I was Airware (W13), and I was an M&A and operations consultant for the Fortune 500 and PE firms (independent & McKinsey). @MIT '07.
